title: Confirm — Response
description: The approver's signed user-decision: subject + challenge are echoed, decision is `approved` or `denied`, and the document's proof is what the relying party verifies.

challenge.description: Echoed from the matching confirm-request. The relying party verifies it equals the bound challenge.

deniedReason.description: Required when decision is `denied`. Human-readable rationale.

Response.title: Confirm Response — relying party ack
Response.description: Acknowledgement the relying party returns after processing the user decision. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/confirm/response/0.1#response.
